Element.Name: initiate_project
Element.attribute: Identify key client stakeholders and establish the core project team with representation from the client and EY. Additionally, develop the project charter and schedule and formally launch the project with the core team.

Element.Name: define_project_manage_plan
Element.attribute: Define the project governance structure, design authority and document the project management plan (PMP).

Element.Name: gather_information
Element.attribute: Review the request for proposal (RFP) and begin populating the requirements traceability matrix (RTM). Gather any additional information needed to better understand the client's current and desired business capabilities and supporting processes.

Element.Name: confirm_target_bus_capab
Element.attribute: Meet with key client stakeholders to confirm the business capabilities that will be part of the future state. Begin identifying the out-of-the-box Oracle process flows and EY pre-solutioned assets needed to enable the in-scope capabilities.

Element.Name: prepare_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: Based on the in-scope business capabilities, schedule workshops with key client stakeholders to analyze whether the associated out-of-the-box Oracle business process flows meet the requirements of the business.

Element.Name: conduct_oracle_trusted_workshops
Element.attribute: Prepare for and conduct Oracle Trusted workshops with key client stakeholders to highlight any risks that could arise from failures around security and controls.

Element.DisplayName: Define Vision and Case for Change
Element.Name: define_vision_case_change
Element.attribute: Define Vision and Case for Change

Define a compelling future state vision for the Oracle services implementation and clearly articulate the reasons for the transformation in a way that resonates with those impacted and helps generate understanding and buy-in.

Element.DisplayName: Define Change Management Strategy and Plan
Element.Name: define_chang_manag_stra_plan
Element.attribute: Define Change Management Strategy and Plan

Create an overarching strategy for organizational change management and training that focuses on maximizing the effectiveness of the Oracle services implementation through business engagement, readiness and adoption.

Element.Name: prep_tech_workshops
Element.attribute: Schedule workshops with key client stakeholders to discuss technical architecture, integrations, development and data conversion.

Element.Name: define_mstr_bus_proc_inv
Element.attribute: Confirm with key client stakeholders the complete set of out-of-the-box Oracle business processes and any EY pre-solutioned process assets that will be included in the target state and identify client process owners.

Element.Name: design_security_controls
Element.attribute: Mark potential risks in to-be (future state) business process flows and begin identifying relevant controls for these risks. Identify the roles and users in the target state Oracle platform and define the security and controls design specifications.

Element.Name: define_ini_backlog_agile
Element.attribute: Define an initial backlog in order to better estimate the work effort and prepare for the progressive build cycles.

Element.Name: plan_prog_build_cycle
Element.attribute: Define the overall implementation plan as well as the release plan that details the configurations and RICEFW objects that will be completed in each build iteration (1-n). Additionally, define the iteration cadence and synchronization of work.

Element.Name: plan
Element.attribute: Kick off the project and define the project management plan (PMP). Review in-scope business capabilities with key client stakeholders. Facilitate security and controls workshops, develop the change management strategy and prepare for the upcoming fit-gap and technical workshops.
